notes: Usage statistics: when your server is connected to Diastema, it now sends Diastema a short daily summary of how much each part of Diastema was used (for example pages opened, treatment plans printed, follow-ups logged and X-ray fixes), day totals in dollars for the X-ray check and printed plans, how many staff signed in, and a few settings. It never includes patient names or details, staff names, or anything typed into Diastema. This helps Diastema decide what to improve.
